# R1: Creator study: @rahulmhinduja

Rahul Hinduja (505K, tech / PC builds, Hinglish) · creator · https://www.instagram.com/rahulmhinduja/ · notes: [creators/rahulmhinduja.md](../../brain/creators/rahulmhinduja.md)

**Core lesson:** A fast, number-first Hinglish tech format: verdict in the first second, something new on screen every 1.2–2 s, yellow brand accent, and a comment-keyword CTA that delivers a living freebie by DM.


## Ideas from this source (43)

- **[No intro: topic and number first](../topics/hooks.md#hook-no-intro-payoff-first)** · hooks: Rahul never greets: the topic and a number (price, score, date) are spoken and on screen in the first 1–2 s. Our playbook: open on the most striking frame plus a hook text of 8 words or fewer; no logos, no slow intros.
- **[Contrarian statement or "don't buy X"](../topics/hooks.md#hook-contrarian-statement)** · hooks: Say something most people believe is false and offer the alternative ("Subscribers, views, likes don't matter…"). Rahul's versions: "Don't buy the RTX 5070", "8 GB GPU in 2026 is a waste of money", "stop paying ₹8,000 a year for Photoshop".
- **[Verdict first: name, price, score](../topics/hooks.md#hook-verdict-first)** · hooks: Rating reels open on the product, its price and an x/10 verdict in the first second, then a one-word justification label ("Core i9 14900K, ₹46,000, 3 out of 10… as hot as a heater").
- **["Do this now": a tiny effort, instant payoff](../topics/hooks.md#hook-do-this-now)** · hooks: The viewer can test it while watching: "put your phone on airplane mode… the code is still changing", or "Aapko pata hai…" change one word in the Gmail URL. The Gmail trick was Rahul's best organic reel at 2.38× followers.
- **[Hyper-local conditional hook](../topics/hooks.md#hook-hyper-local-conditional)** · hooks: Call out a specific place and moment: "If you're going to Nehru Place or Lamington Road this weekend to build a PC, listen before you enter the shop…", with real market names as road-sign graphics.
- **[Sarcastic or date-stamped mockery opener](../topics/hooks.md#hook-sarcastic-opener)** · hooks: Open with mockery tied to a date or price ("Thinking of a ₹1 lakh PC in October 2026? The shopkeeper will laugh at you") or sarcastic congratulations ("Wow, congratulations! ₹75,000… your first PC").
- **[Study one same-niche creator deeply](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-study-one-creator-deeply)** · ideas: Our Rahul file benchmarks one same-niche creator in depth: 12 reels downloaded and measured (cuts, beats, loudness, hooks, CTAs).
- **[Universal tricks reach, niche builds engage](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-universal-vs-niche-reach)** · ideas: In Rahul's sample, universal everyday-tech tricks (Gmail, 2.38× followers) got the most non-follower reach; PC-build reels got the highest like rates (4.8–5.3%); AI "debunk" content was weakest.
- **[Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s)** · editing: Change something (cut, layout swap, label, card, animation) every 1.5–2.5 s (L01, L02). Rahul measured at roughly every 1.2–2 s in every reel; his sponsored Flipkart reel was the fastest at 1.2 s.
- **[Cut every breath and pause](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-breaths-no-dead-air)** · editing: Jump cuts remove breaths (the ReCut method in action). Rahul's reels have no dead air: under 2.5% of 100 ms windows sit 25 dB below the median level.
- **[Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face)** · editing: Graphic on top, face below, switching to full face for key lines (L01); Rahul's animated top ~55% over a face cam; L04's red step board under the face; long-form: 9:16 examples in rounded windows on the left ~40%, speaker on the right (L06).
- **[Switch layouts every few seconds](../topics/editing.md#edit-layout-switching)** · editing: Rahul's organic reels switch between full-frame talking head with pop-up labels, screen/card with circular face cam, and 1–3 s meme cutaways every few seconds instead of holding one layout.
- **[Screen content with a circular face cam](../topics/editing.md#edit-screen-card-circle-facecam)** · editing: Screen recordings fill the frame with a circular face cam: Rahul bottom-centre with a yellow ring and an app-logo badge; Oren in dark rounded cards with drop shadows plus a floating circular PiP camera.
- **[Meme cutaways with the product pasted in](../topics/editing.md#edit-meme-cutaways)** · editing: 1–3 s full-screen meme cutaways (Bollywood, Joker, DiCaprio, Messi) with the price or product composited in; often reused as the cover.
- **[Show proof on screen](../topics/editing.md#edit-proof-inserts)** · editing: Rahul inserts article, doc and GitHub screenshots with yellow highlighter on the key line; Oren runs live tool walkthroughs as proof.

- **[Yellow caps labels and big ₹ figures](../topics/text.md#text-yellow-condensed-labels)** · text: Heavy condensed all-caps yellow labels of 1–3 words on a black box ("WI-FI OFF"), large yellow ₹ figures with a drop shadow, and receipt-style or dark UI data cards that look like real documents.

- **[Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice)** · text: Rahul speaks Hindi/Hinglish with English or Hinglish on-screen captions; our caption voice switches between English and Hinglish by theme (Khandala reel: Hinglish, chill).

- **[Near-black with one accent colour](../topics/colour.md#colour-near-black-one-accent)** · colour: The easing tutorial is near-black with a red glow, red as the only accent; Rahul uses yellow (≈ #F5B800) on black as his single brand accent everywhere.
- **[Fixed set and colour identity](../topics/brand.md#brand-fixed-set-identity)** · brand: Rahul's set never changes (purple/blue wash, warm lamp, mic on an arm) with a yellow accent; he talks straight to lens, sarcastic ("Come on Intel") with lots of gestures, recognisable at thumbnail size.
- **[Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta)** · growth: "Comment 'hooks' and I'll send it to you": a comment-to-DM freebie, with social proof (700K views) raising its value.
